title: Add refund retry support for the merchant portal

provenance.author: agent
provenance.selfReview: The change was reported as complete and correct, with the new test cited as evidence that retries behave.

defects.summary: The redact() sanitiser was removed from the error path, so the whole authorise request, including the PAN, reaches the application log.
defects.notes: A regex over source finds nothing here. The PAN is never written literally, it travels inside req. Only the taint hook follows the value.

defects.summary: reissueRefund retries up to maxAttempts, and the only test covering it asserts a count. Nothing pins the retry bound.
defects.notes: The surviving mutant changes <= to <, dropping one retry. The new test still passes, which is the proof that it proves nothing.

defects.summary: Scheme fee rounding changed from half-up to floor. The merchant is paid one cent more on some amounts and the fee account is short.
defects.notes: Silent to the suite, because fee plus net still equals the captured amount and no test asserts the split. Four corpus rows diverge.

defects.summary: A new card constant was added for the retry tests.
defects.notes: Listed as a defect because pan-scan reports it. It is not one. See R0-P1.

defects.summary: reissueRefund makes a second identical refund reachable from support tooling. No requirement says whether two identical refund requests are one refund or two.
defects.notes: Every check is green on this. The money stays inside the guard, the ledger balances, the invariants hold. specs/product/payments.md section 'Retries' covers authorise and capture and is silent on refund. Escalate to payments-product. Do not choose a policy.

pathologies.summary: pan-scan reports RETRY_TEST_CARD as an unallowlisted Luhn-valid PAN.
pathologies.reason: RETRY_TEST_CARD is a published Mastercard scheme test card, BIN 510510. It is synthetic. The allowlist in workbench/hooks/pan-scan.ts is incomplete, which is a gap in the hook rather than a defect in the change. Fix the allowlist, do not remove the fixture.

pathologies.summary: Mutating sum + e.amount to sum - e.amount in Ledger.net() survives on the main branch.
pathologies.reason: Entries are always written as balanced pairs, so negating every term negates a sum that is already zero. No test can kill this mutant because the mutation changes no reachable behaviour. Writing a test for it is wasted work. Run the workflow on main to meet it.

pathologies.summary: scope-guard reports nothing, and a green row is easy to read as a pass.
pathologies.reason: It did not run. There is no allowed-paths manifest for this change, so it examined nothing. The bundle records this as silence, and F6 appears in notExamined. A green scope-guard row would be a different claim entirely.
